scope: Anonymous published CMS API snapshots and all164 public rendered article pages. Read-only; no CMS changes.
scoringLimitations: Canonical analyzer scores are internal editorial-readiness heuristics, not independent factual audits, Google rankings, probabilities or delivery-gate editorial scores.

Markdown exports omit runtime JSON-LD; all164 rendered pages contain Article/BlogPosting, Person author and BreadcrumbList. Analyzer missing-schema penalties are export artifacts and are not valid website defects.
CMS title rendered as sole H1 in exports; all164 live pages have exactly one H1.
No substantiated incorrect competitor quote was established by this audit; changing quotes were not exhaustively reverified. Do not represent this as a fresh commercial fact-check of106 comparisons.
Technical health does not prove originality, search demand, product superiority or conversion performance.

findings.evidence: All164 sampled article pages contain sameAs links to Shopify/WhatsApp Wikipedia/Wikidata entities, +1-800-WHATFLOW placeholder, US address and unverified organization profiles.
findings.action: Remove false identity equivalences and unverified contact/entity properties; keep confirmed WhatFlow identities. Root implementing.

findings.evidence: SearchAction target uses /blog?search= but real site search uses q.
findings.action: Use actual q parameter or remove unsupported action. Root implementing.

findings.evidence: 339 body screenshot placements use16 distinct screenshots. Template-editor WebP repeats119 times; Flow order-reply JPG60 times; Flow triggers JPG37 times.
findings.action: Capture real inbox, catalog, customer/order extensions, buttons and broadcast configuration; use only screenshots that show the actual claim. Prioritize inbox and catalog pages. Preserve honest sample-data captions.

findings.evidence: 105 comparisons share the same generic budget caveat paragraph;70 share free-button explanatory paragraph;65 share four generic section headings;64 titles end Shopify features, inbox and pricing.
findings.action: Retain short accurate common cost notes but replace unnecessary repetition with specific counterpart pricing inputs, concrete workflow boundaries and evidence. Give priority competitors unique titles/angles. Repeated legal/product truth alone is not proof of duplicate-content penalty.

findings.evidence: Pages discuss Shopify-derived audiences and WhatFlow workflows without explicitly stating native audience/customer-segment sync remains upcoming. They do not explicitly claim sync is live.
findings.action: Add precise current boundary near product recommendation: audience/segment sync is upcoming; describe only presently supported recipient-selection/import/Flow paths after verifying actual interface. Do not promise automatic synchronization.

findings.scope: Direct commerce competitors: Wati, Interakt, Zoko, AiSensy
findings.evidence: Vendor catalog features are described, but WhatFlow live catalog sharing has no dedicated genuine screenshot among16 body screenshot assets.
findings.action: Show current WhatFlow catalog-sharing workflow and distinguish catalog sharing from ongoing catalog or audience synchronization.

findings.evidence: Email/SMS/retargeting comparisons share cart-recovery topic; token overlap is only a candidate signal. No GSC query-to-URL evidence exists.
findings.action: Preserve distinct channel buying intent, cross-link to implementation guide, avoid new near-identical cart articles. Do not merge or redirect from title overlap alone.

findings.evidence: No merchant performance measurements validated in this audit; content correctly labels scenarios hypothetical.
findings.action: Add permissioned real merchant case studies and instrument article-to-install conversion; do not relabel hypothetical scenarios as merchant results.

findings.evidence: 9 meta titles exceed60 characters;31 descriptions exceed160 by1–5 characters. These are preview warnings, not indexing failures.
findings.action: Adjust only where meaning improves; avoid padded templates and avoid enforcing rigid character quotas.
